t: 弗吉尼亚州颁布托马斯·杰斐逊撰写的《宗教自由法》。
te: Virginia enacts the Statute for Religious Freedom authored by Thomas Jefferson.
dz: 弗吉尼亚州颁布托马斯·杰斐逊撰写的《宗教自由法》。
de: Virginia enacts the Statute for Religious Freedom authored by Thomas Jefferson.

t: 十天前的地震在大渡河上修建的滑坡坝倒塌，造成中国四川省 10 万人死亡。
te: A landslide dam on the Dadu River created by an earthquake ten days earlier collapses, killing 100,000 in the Sichuan p…
dz: 十天前的地震在大渡河上修建的滑坡坝倒塌，造成中国四川省 10 万人死亡。
de: A landslide dam on the Dadu River created by an earthquake ten days earlier collapses, killing 100,000 in the Sichuan province of China.

t: 加夫里尔·普里比洛夫在白令海发现了普里比洛夫群岛的圣乔治岛.
te: Gavriil Pribylov discovers St. George Island of the Pribilof Islands in the Bering Sea.
dz: 加夫里尔·普里比洛夫在白令海发现了普里比洛夫群岛的圣乔治岛.
de: Gavriil Pribylov discovers St. George Island of the Pribilof Islands in the Bering Sea.

dz: 亚历山大·麦克多内尔(Alexander Macdonell)和超过500名罗马天主教高地人离开苏格兰去安大略省格伦加里县定居.
de: Alexander Macdonell and over five hundred Roman Catholic highlanders leave Scotland to settle in Glengarry County, Ontario.

t: 首个联邦印第安保留地由美国创建.
te: The first federal Indian Reservation is created by the United States.
dz: 首个联邦印第安保留地由美国创建.
de: The first federal Indian Reservation is created by the United States.

t: 法国-意大利边境的勃朗峰由雅克·巴尔马特和米歇尔-加布里埃尔·帕克卡尔博士首次攀登.
te: Mont Blanc on the French-Italian border is climbed for the first time by Jacques Balmat and Dr. Michel-Gabriel Paccard.
dz: 法国-意大利边境的勃朗峰由雅克·巴尔马特和米歇尔-加布里埃尔·帕克卡尔博士首次攀登.
de: Mont Blanc on the French-Italian border is climbed for the first time by Jacques Balmat and Dr. Michel-Gabriel Paccard.

t: 弗朗西斯·莱特船长在马来西亚建立了英国的槟城殖民地.
te: Captain Francis Light establishes the British colony of Penang in Malaysia.
dz: 弗朗西斯·莱特船长在马来西亚建立了英国的槟城殖民地.
de: Captain Francis Light establishes the British colony of Penang in Malaysia.

te: Shays' Rebellion, an armed uprising of Massachusetts farmers, begins in response to high debt and tax burdens.
dz: Shays' Rebellion是马萨诸塞州农民的武装起义,开始于应对沉重的债务和税收负担.
de: Shays' Rebellion, an armed uprising of Massachusetts farmers, begins in response to high debt and tax burdens.

t: 安纳波利斯公约的开始.
te: The beginning of the Annapolis Convention.
dz: 安纳波利斯公约的开始.
de: The beginning of the Annapolis Convention.

t: 秘鲁安第斯山脉的万卡韦利卡矿倒塌,造成200多人死亡. 这一事件是西班牙帝国汞生产的一大挫折.
te: The mine of Huancavelica in the Peruvian Andes collapses, killing more than two hundred people. The event was a major s…
dz: 秘鲁安第斯山脉的万卡韦利卡矿倒塌,造成200多人死亡. 这一事件是西班牙帝国汞生产的一大挫折.
de: The mine of Huancavelica in the Peruvian Andes collapses, killing more than two hundred people. The event was a major setback for mercury production in the Spanish Empire.

te: The oldest musical organization in the United States is founded as the Stoughton Musical Society.
dz: 美国最古老的音乐会组织被创立为斯德顿音乐会.
de: The oldest musical organization in the United States is founded as the Stoughton Musical Society.

dz: 皮埃特罗·利奥波多一世统治下的托斯卡纳大公国成为第一个废除死刑的现代州(后被纪念为"城市生活日").
